ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Huge Things Test Races (harness only)
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
HARNESS ONLY. Never shipped, never on a player's list.
Three elephant-bodied test races so Huge Things' titan tiers can be measured on a minimal mod list (no vanilla race reaches body size 8): - RM_TestTitanT2: body size 8 (the T2 floor). - RM_TestTitanT3: body size 20 (the T3 floor). - RM_TestTitanT2Control: body size 8, forced out of tiering (RM_TitanicExtension forceEnabled=false): the same-mass untiered control for the butcher yield curve.
No biome lists them and they carry no trade tags, so they appear only when a test spawns them. Item TITANIC_BODYSIZE_TEST_RACE_1.
